notes.title: Highlight has been nominated for the Gamebakery award for "best student game"!
notes.notes:
Highlight has been nominated for the Gamebakery award as "best student game"!
We are thrilled to see that this transmedial concept is viable. We think that it has a lot of potential for bigger video game productions. We'd love to work on something like that in the future!

[url=https://control-online.nl/gamesindustrie/2020/03/02/stem-nu-voor-de-winnaars-van-de-game-bakery-awards/]You can find the other nominated games on this page![/url]

notes.title: We sold a hundred copies!
notes.notes: We are happy to announce that we sold our first hundred copies and we are very happy with the feedback we got. This is our first release and people seem to be happy with the result. We are also happy to announce that Highlight is now also downloadable in Brasil!

notes.title: First day patch! - Videos stutter or crash the game!
notes.notes: Some people were having issues with high processor usage when loading the in-game videos. This patch will half the processor usage when loading these videos.
